response.rationale: The clinical picture of new-onset heart failure with severe LV dysfunction in the setting of a tachyarrhythmia (abrupt rate changes, PACs) and no other cause favors tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy. R3 is a descriptive syndrome, not the underlying etiology.

rejected.why: ECG shows P waves with 1:1 AV relationship, excluding atrial fibrillation.
Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction is a syndrome, not the most specific diagnosis; it does not address the underlying tachyarrhythmia as the cause.
